title: On Cooking the fish over a low fire
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：cook　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cook 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the clerk ① cooked the fish over a low fire without a word of thanks, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② cooks the fish over a low fire at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cook the fish over a low fire at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cooked the fish over a low fire before — a line in the file for May 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Cooking the fish over a low fire without a word of thanks, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cook for twenty men every noon at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cook for twenty men every noon at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ cooks for twenty men every noon without a word of thanks every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cooked the fish over a low fire again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cook the fish over a low fire, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody cooks the fish over a low fire at once again and somebody must cook the fish over a low fire without a word of thanks all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cook 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the clerk cooked the fish over a low fire without a word of thanks, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk cooks the fish over a low fire at once whenever the office asks.
Cooking the fish over a low fire without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cook for twenty men every noon at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office cooks for twenty men every noon without a word of thanks every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cooked the fish over a low fire again, and the office remembered that half.
